answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) trained to predict the next token from a lengthy context have demonstrated impressive machine translation capabilities...
datasets: WMT test sets (2021 for German and Chinese, 2014 for French)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate sentence-level translation quality using recommended practices for high-quality MT, specifically: ... (ii) we use a SOTA automatic metric (BLEURT) instead of BLEU...

answer_4.quote: To perform human evaluation, we hired professional translators ... and measure translation quality with a document-context version of MQM...
answer_4.guideline: MQM (Multidimensional Quality Metrics) with error categories, severity levels, and weighting schema
